summary: Winston County, MS lookout registered 2016 as US 1617; reported cut down by November 2012 with remains on the ground. No build or staffing sources found.

facts.status_note: Register says it had been cut down as of November 2012, with remains on the ground next to where it stood; no removal date given

events.note: As of November 2012 the register reports the lookout cut down; the removal date itself is not given
Registered May 27, 2016 as US 1617, MS 2; nominated by Ron Stafford

evidence.supports: lookout reported cut down as of November 2012; remains on the ground next to where it stood
evidence.quote: As of November 2012, Handle Lookout had been cut down. Its remain were on the ground next to where it formerly stood.

evidence.supports: Handle is a post-hamlet of Winston County, about 15 miles southwest of Louisville, the county seat (encyclopedia entry)
evidence.quote: Handle, a post-hamlet of Winston county, about 15 miles southwest of Louisville, the county seat.

evidence.supports: register links to Google Earth imagery (not viewed for the story)

notes_for_editor: Only the Former Fire Lookout Sites page describes this lookout. No source found gives its construction date, design, height, staffing, fires or current condition, so the story omits them. Searches for a Winston County or Mississippi Forestry Commission record of the tower turned up nothing. The Commercial Dispatch article was 410 Gone. Leads for an editor: Mississippi Forestry Commission records, Mississippi State University Special Collections photo archive.
